name: publishProviderConfigs
description: Guest pushes effective provider configs (from settings.json providers.configs) to the C++ LLM broker so it configures providers from settings.json and refreshes the pref cold-boot cache.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.description: { configs: {<providerId>: {apiKey,baseUrl,defaultModel,model,enabledModels,userAgent,...}}, activeProviderId?: string } dict. userAgent: a preset User-Agent the provider sends on its requests; '' or absent = the host default.
